indexes: fts5 index on content with book_id, page_number, book_title, author, category UNINDEXED

dataModels.name: UnifiedSearchResult
dataModels.indexes: N/A (computed at query time via RRF)

testingStrategy: Unit: schema decode success/failure, FTS5 insert idempotency, hash computation, BM25 ranking, RRF fusion weights, dual-stemmer coverage ≥96%, alias map 131 entries, indexShipped: false. Integration: full Shamela ingest → search → article suggestions pipeline (corpus lane), MCP tool call sequence, cross-collection retrieval, article determinism (10 runs byte-identical). Security: injection payloads in Shamela API response, malicious MCP tool args, no Shamela text in logs/traces, license-gated book exclusion assertion. Performance: ingest ≥100 pages/sec, FTS5 query p95 ≤800ms, RRF fusion p95 ≤800ms, root-coverage ≤30min. Gates: G-5 license gate planted violation, G-7.6 undeclared display module, G-7.13 completeness claim without denominator. CI: Shamela tests in corpus lane, root-coverage test in corpus lane, default lane corpus-free.
